text:
sam.r: Incident alert: several customers reported duplicated tokens in streaming chat responses from hosted region us-east1 around 08:12 UTC. Sync endpoints OK. Opening incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3177777777

sre-lee: Verified in traces 4c duplicate chunks with same seq_id emitted during connection failover. Suspect multiplexing client retry + proxy reconnection race.

emily.z: Deploying mitigation: disable client-side streaming retries for us-east1 and enable ingress dedupe (5s window) at the mux. Canary 5% now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: ingress-config/us-east1/dedupe-canary=5%

sre-lee: Canary results: duplication rate reduced from ~2.4x -> ~1.08x. No latency regressions. Ramp to 50% in 10m.
emily.z: Rolling to 100% now. Also adding a telemetry gate to emit events when a seq_id repeats more than once per request.

sre-lee: 100% rollout complete at 3177777815. Duplication is back within noise. No customer escalations after 15m. Keeping incident open for 30m monitoring.

status-page-bot: Public status: "Investigating - some hosted streaming responses may contain duplicated tokens in us-east1. Mitigation rolling; updates to follow."

sam.r: Owners: eng-runtime (emily.z) for root cause, eng-sre (sre-lee) for monitoring and rollback plan. Postmortem planned within 72h.

emily.z: Short-term PR posted to remove one retry path in the client lib and add unit tests. Long-term: redesign handshake/ack semantics. Filing RFC.

sre-lee: Action items: 1) postmortem + timeline, 2) add canary checks for duplicate seq_ids, 3) customer outreach draft.

sam.r: Thanks all. Final public update planned after monitoring window. If anything spikes, page oncall. :thumbsup:
